title: Tutorial Disable – Zero Clutter UI Mod
description: This mod disables the tutorial pop-ups
body:
Tutorial Disable is a lightweight client-side Minecraft mod that removes the tutorial popups in the top-right corner of the screen.

No extra buttons, no setup, and no configuration required — just install the mod and the tutorial messages are gone.

This mod focuses on a zero-clutter experience, keeping your UI clean and letting you focus on gameplay without distractions.
